answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sparrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the nadir of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the meadow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
